task: VED Initial-Window EV Trip Distance Prediction
target_definition: Total trip distance in kilometres, derived via trapezoidal integration of speed over the completed trip for pure-EV trips with >= 95% speed-distance coverage. Estimated at t = 30 seconds using the initial 30-second telemetry window.

split.method: Vehicle-grouped holdout: Vehicle 10 test (12 trips), Vehicle 541 & partial 455 val (8 trips), Vehicle 455 train (31 trips)

experiments.description: Predicts training set mean distance (2.601 km)

limitations: Dataset includes only 3 pure-EV vehicles, all 2013 Nissan Leafs.
Vehicle 10 is the only completely unseen vehicle identity in the held-out test split (12 trips).
Initial 30-second window captures early driving style and speed profile, but cannot anticipate arbitrary route changes or unexpected trip endpoints.
Results are exploratory and should not be presented as a generalized commercial range prediction model.
